Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong experience building modern full-stack applications, with a focus on React, Node.js, and MongoDB. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain web applications end-to-end—working across the frontend, backend, and data layers to deliver scalable, reliable products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop user-facing features using React and modern frontend practices.
  • Build and maintain backend services with Node.js, ensuring performance, security, and reliability.
  • Design, implement, and optimize database solutions using MongoDB.
  • Work across the stack to integrate APIs, handle data flow, and ensure smooth end-to-end functionality.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to define requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing systems.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proficiency with React for frontend development.
  • Experience with Node.js for backend development and RESTful/API design.
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including data modeling and query optimization.
  • Strong understanding of full-stack development workflows and integration patterns.
  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and design principles.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and communicate clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux) and modern React patterns.
  • Familiarity with authentication/authorization mechanisms (e.g., JWT, OAuth).
  • Experience with testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of performance optimization for both frontend and backend systems.


Additional Information

This position is ideal for a developer who thrives in full-stack environments and enjoys building end-to-end solutions using React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
